scientific_integrity: A full operator-theoretic proof is supplied; finite tests are supplemental and no infinite statement depends on them.
scientific_limitations: The primary power criterion assumes strictly positive bounded unilateral weights. The two examples are exact and the hyponormal rigidity holds in this class; extension to zero weights, bilateral shifts, or arbitrary operators is not proved. Priority against unindexed historical literature is unresolved; no independent scientific validation or audit has occurred.
title: Power stability of reducing-subspace norm attainment for unilateral weighted shifts
